# skill-artifact-loop Fixture

This fixture documents the Story 2.5 minimum release-gate surface:

- installed IDE entry discovery
- activation protocol from installed `SKILL.md`
- `speclite resolve config` and `speclite resolve customization` access
- workflow artifact write into configured artifact root
- required metadata value-domain validation
- `generatedAt` snapshot normalization

It intentionally does not validate workflow prose quality, human review conclusions, dashboard metrics or full Epic 6 release matrix behavior.
